claims.evidence: Photo 0 front panel shows the brand and model name.
Photo 0 shows an electric foot pedal and power cord.

risks.proof: A video clip of the machine powered on and stitching through a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged bobbin case and needle bar
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the bobbin compartment and the needle assembly area.

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues or frayed internal wiring
risks.proof: A video showing the machine running without electrical arcing or smoke.

risks.risk: Permanent cosmetic damage or heavy corrosion
risks.proof: Clear photos of the back, underside, and a close-up of the stained areas.
risks.if_unproven: as poor condition with significant staining

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing a test pattern to prove motor and timing function.
Photo of the bobbin area with the cover open.
Photos of the back and underside of the machine.
Photo of any included accessories or carrying case.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the specific model as an IDEAL TOPSTAR Super Automatik, which allows for a valuation at its worst-case (non-functional/dirty) state.
